local: ¡Salve, Oh Patria, mil veces, oh Patria!
Ya tu pecho, tu pecho, rebosa,
gozo y paz ya tu pecho rebosa;
english: Hail, Oh Fatherland, a thousand times! Oh Fatherland,
Glory be to you! Glory be to you!
Now your breast, your breast, overflows,
Now your breast overflows with joy and peace;

local: Y tu frente, tu frente radiosa,
Más que el sol contemplamos lucir.
Los primeros, los hijos del suelo
english: And your forehead, your radiant forehead
we contemplate shining more than the Sun.
The firsts, the sons of the soil

local: y vertieron su sangre por ti.
Dios miró y aceptó el holocausto
english: Declared you as their sovereign lady forever,
And shed their blood for you.
God observed and accepted the holocaust,

local: y esa sangre fue germen fecundo
de otros héroes que atónito el mundo
vió en tu torno a millares surgir.
english: And that blood was the fertile germ
Of other heroes whom the world in astonishment
Saw rise up around you by the thousands.
